bandReport.notes: Items 45-86, contiguous, no gaps, no repeats. Item 45 opens whole at the top of p16-c1; item 86 ends whole at the foot of p28-c2 ('[ P.T.O.'), so neither band edge is cut. All seven pages are English; faint Hindi show-through from the verso ignored. These are duplicated letters only: every c1 line is complete in the c1 crop, no text was lost, and no workaround via the whole page was needed. Item 48 option (a) prints '1 .and 2' with a stray dot (scan speck), recorded as '1 and 2'. Items 48, 49 and 71 print '1 and 2' / '1 and 3' without 'only', as printed. Item 53 option (a) prints 'improvement of roof houses' and (c) 'forest area produces', transcribed as printed. Italics in titles (items 51, 65, 78, 80) not marked. No FIGURE items.
